WabbitEmu.js and WabbitEmu.wasm are Wabbitemu's core (GPLv2 or later), built from
https://github.com/marwatk/wasmwabbitemu/tree/07f0ac6ec605a245df43ffe9821b4c9abbdabf55
with TIde's bridge, ../tide_wabbit.cpp, by ../build.sh using the emscripten/emsdk:3.1.74 image:

  git clone https://github.com/marwatk/wasmwabbitemu.git wabbit
  git -C wabbit checkout 07f0ac6ec605a245df43ffe9821b4c9abbdabf55
  docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/w" -w /w emscripten/emsdk:3.1.74 sh emulator/wabbit/build.sh wabbit emulator/wabbit/dist

TIde builds them into the app.
